asr.full_text: It's been a long day but now you're home. You flip on the TV before you start eating your dinner and as you take the first bite you close your eyes and you just enjoy the way that it tastes. But when you open your eyes staring right back at you is a starving child in Africa covered in flies. How do you look at something like that and not want to help? Of course you want to do something. So, you call the number on the screen and donate $100. Look, we've all seen that commercial and it sucks, it really does. Hunger, extreme poverty, high mortality rates, all this stuff that's happening in third world countries is horrific, and even though we might give a little money from time to time, that's usually about as close as we ever get to it. But what if you could help in a more meaningful way?! What if you can go to a country like Nepal… Like actually take an expedition to Nepal with a small group of people who want to end extreme poverty there…. That'd be awesome right.. Yeah… Of course it would…. So keep watching because there is more, you're about to become part of a story that started over 34 years ago when Dr. Tim Evans learned from one of his patients about a young girl living in a small Bolivian village who dined needlessly after drinking contaminated water. Dr. Evans soon found this village had an urgent need for a reliable source of clean water and he wanted to do something about it. One thing lead to another and he ended up founding the Andean Children's Foundation where he worked with his partners to install the first hand dug wells in Bolivia. What's interesting is that once the clean supply of water was saving lives, the villagers discovered that they could also save their crops and even make a little money during the dry season. At this point, Dr. Evans met Dr. James Mayfield, a political science professor at the University of Utah with 20 years experience in village development that included work for UCEDD UNESCO and the United Nations. Dr. Mayfield joined ACF's Board of Directors and the two of them got busy raising money and helping villages. But it didn't take long for them to realize that they needed a different program. So they founded Choice Humanitarian to raise the money to fund ACF projects. a couple of successful expeditions the Andeean Children's Foundation merged with Choice Humanitarian and today Choice Humanitarian operates in seven countries when you join project etherium a portion of your donations will directly fund Choice Humanitarian and you'll have the chance to travel on expeditions to help people in Nepal, Bolivia, Kenya, Mexico, Guatemala, Ecuador, and Peru. You'll install water wells, build schools, help disaster victims, and get to know the people you're helping. It's so much more than just sending money! At Project Ethereum, our ability to support Choice Humanitarian comes from new opportunities and rising values in cryptocurrencies. You've probably heard about Ethereum and Bitcoin, but when you join Project Ethereum, you'll be part of a very small group of people around the world who are actually investing in and using these technologically advanced currencies. With your monthly subscription to Project Ethereum, you'll have access to select courses in our crypto university. You'll receive monthly lessons, newsletters, and tips from leading experts. When you get started, you'll receive a free copy of our ebook where you'll discover some of the best kept secrets about cryptocurrency investments and avoid the kind of mistakes that new investors typically make. We're going to be conducting live training sessions on topics like mining options, buying and selling different types of currencies, the different currency wallet types, how to set up your wallet, how to use your wallet. Your monthly membership in Project Ethereum also includes a free membership in our Forced Matrix comp plan where you can potentially receive up to 510 direct donations each and every month. After you secure your position in the matrix, you'll receive your first donation when the next person joins your team. Because it's a F.O.R.C.E matrix, whether you bring in the next person yourself or one of your upline sponsors brings them You're the one, who gets the donation. So, let's say that you become a member for $90 today. This will secure your position on the team and in this stage the first person, who signs ETH, the first person who signs up under you and donation $90 of Ethereum will send that donation directly to you. The next person to join under you will also send $90 of Ethereum directly to you. You are going to take those first two $90 donations and donate $180 directly to the person two levels above you. In stage two, the two people under you will sign up their two people and the four people on your second level are going to send you $180 each when they upgrade to stage two Just like you sent $180 directly to person two levels above you when you upgrade to stage two out of that $720 from these four people you're gonna send $360 to the person three levels above you in order to upgrade to Stage 3 and in Stage 3 you qualify to receive $360 from the eight people on your third level for up to $2880 in donations in order for you to upgrade to stage four you'll donate $900 which is two and a half donations that you've received and you're going to send that $900 directly to the person four levels above you and in this case you keep up to $1,980 in Ethereum. To move from stage 4 to stage 5 you'll take two of the $900 donations that you received from your fourth level and send $1,800 directly to the person five levels above you and keep up to $12600 in ETH. To move from Stage 5 to Stage 6, take 2 of the $1800 donations you receive from your 5th level and send $3600 directly to the person 6 levels above you and keep up to $54000 in ETH. Hopefully you're starting to see the patterns. Now to move from stage six to stage seven you'll take two of the $3,600 donations that you receive from your sixth level and send $7,200 directly to the person seven levels above you and keep up to $223,300 in ethereum to move from stage seven to stage eight you'll take two of the seventy two hundred dollar donations that you receive from your seventh level and send fourteen thousand four hundred dollars directly to the person eight levels above you and keep up to nine hundred and seven thousand two hundred dollars in Ethereum. Stage Eight is winner take all and in order for all two hundred and fifty six people on your eighth level to move to Stage Eight they'll need to send you $14,400 in ETH, so you can make up to $3,686,400 in ETH in stage eight. All eight stages put together add up to $4.8 million per month in ETH donations. We've made the sign up process as simple as possible with a step-by-step tutorial that anyone can follow to get started on your team. Each week you'll have access to support calls Monday through Friday in multiple languages. Your membership includes an assortment of duplicatable marketing funnels and other tools that the pros use every single day. Join Project Ethereum today and start building your wealth with our advanced team building compensation plan. Soon you'll be joining us on our expeditions with Choice Humanitarian where you'll be helping the people that need the help the most. Be sure to click the link on this page to get started.
